_note: V1.4a's verbs, on the effects.company channel. Two intensities and a withdrawal, so the dial is visibly a dial rather than a single on/off the model could have hard-coded. A subsidy is STANDING state, so there is no cooldown: `subsidy_active` is the gate, and going from the smaller package to the larger one means withdrawing first, which costs the political ground the first one bought.

actions.name: Industrial Subsidy
actions.summary: A standing public subsidy. The firm takes market share from its domestic rivals for as long as the money flows, and keeps what it has taken when it stops.

actions.name: Strategic Rescue Package
actions.summary: The state underwrites the firm outright. Twice the effect and more than twice the argument -- money on this scale is visibly money not spent on something else.

actions.name: Withdraw Support
actions.summary: The subsidy ends. The bill stops, the political credit is handed back, and the market share the firm won with public money stays won.
